# thinkpad

ThinkPad T14 hardware: microcode, audio DSP firmware, Intel video drivers, fingerprint reader, firmware updates and TLP power management.

TLP alone manages power: `setup.sh` removes power-profiles-daemon (it conflicts) and thermald (it exits on this T14: the firmware handles thermals). systemd-rfkill stays, since TLP's radio options are unused here.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`thinkpad/packages`): `intel-ucode`, `sof-firmware`, `intel-media-driver`, `vulkan-intel`, `fprintd`, `fwupd`, `tlp`

**System files** (installed by `setup.sh`, sudo): `/etc/tlp.d/10-thinkpad.conf`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): power management by TLP alone (idempotent). power-profiles-daemon conflicts with TLP; thermald exits on this T14 ("can't run on this platform": firmware (thinkpad_acpi DYTC) handles thermals), so both are removed. systemd-rfkill only conflicts with TLP's radio options (DEVICES_TO_*), unused here: kept so Wi-Fi/Bluetooth on/off survives reboots.
